name: wechat-attachment-organizer
description: WeChat PC local attachment organizer: scan files, classify by type/customer, decode .dat, sha256 dedup, safe copy, and import into the library for full-text search.

displayDescription.en: Scans WeChat PC local attachments, classifies by type/customer, decodes .dat to real formats, dedups by sha256, safely copies without deleting sources, and imports to the library for search.
displayDescription.zh: 扫描微信本地附件，按类型或客户分类、解码.dat、sha256去重，安全复制不删源，可入库检索。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我扫描微信里的附件，按类型分类整理到文件夹
defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan my WeChat attachments and organize them by type into folders

quickPrompts.en: Scan my WeChat attachments and organize them by type into folders
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我扫描微信里的附件，按类型分类整理到文件夹

quickPrompts.en: Sort my WeChat files into folders by client/customer
quickPrompts.zh: 按客户把微信收到的文件归类到对应目录

quickPrompts.en: Show me duplicate WeChat files and how much space I can save
quickPrompts.zh: 先看看微信里有哪些重复文件，能省多少空间
